notes.title: Patch notes! 0.001
notes.notes:
Small updates for our favorite players.

 - Fixed ability "Healing" now deals damage to the enemy player.
 - Fixed ability "Quick Help" heals all of the clan, except your enemies.
 - Chat added to the game.
 - Added rating system.
 - And also many minor corrections.

notes.title: Rating system.
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/w8s9EmG.gif[/img]

From 12.09.2018 the rating system will be opened and the bots will be removed from the game. At the end of each match you will be awarded rating points. During the month, the points are summed up. Your place in the ranking you can see on the site http://thebattleofages.com/ladder

The winners will receive prizes in the form of unique characters models on first day of the month.

In order to win you need to be in top 3.

notes.title: Bonus on launch day
notes.notes:
